# Meridian Analytics — Employee Onboarding Guide

Welcome to Meridian Analytics! This guide covers everything you need for a smooth first week. If anything is unclear, reach out to your manager or HR.

---

## Day 1 Setup

### Accounts & Access
- [ ] Receive your Meridian email (`<firstname>.<lastname>@meridiananalytics.io`) from IT
- [ ] Set up Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive)
- [ ] Activate your Slack account and join `#general`, `#engineering`, `#announcements`
- [ ] Log in to the Meridian Analytics platform at `app.meridiananalytics.io`
- [ ] Set up 1Password (password manager) — your vault invite arrives by email
- [ ] Enable MFA on all company accounts before Day 2

### Physical / Badge
- [ ] Collect your office keycard from Kenji Obi (HR Manager) — desk 4B, second floor
- [ ] Sign the equipment acceptance form for your assigned laptop
- [ ] Take a building safety briefing with the office manager

### Tools to Install
| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| Slack | Team communication |
| Zoom | Video calls |
| GitHub | Source code (Engineering) |
| Figma | Design collaboration (Product/Engineering) |
| Notion | Internal documentation |

---

## Week 1 Tasks

- [ ] 1:1 with your direct manager (Day 1, 30 min)
- [ ] Team introduction call — attend `#standup` at 9:30 am daily
- [ ] Read the Company Handbook in Notion (link shared on Day 1)
- [ ] Complete Security Awareness training (mandatory, ~45 min)
- [ ] Complete GDPR & Data Handling training (mandatory, ~30 min)
- [ ] Shadow a colleague in your team for half a day
- [ ] Submit your signed offer letter copy and ID documents to Kenji Obi
- [ ] Set up your direct deposit and benefits enrolment in Rippling (deadline: Day 5)

---

## Key Contacts

| Name | Role | Department | Email |
|------|------|------------|-------|
| Kenji Obi | HR Manager | HR | k.obi@meridiananalytics.io |
| Priya Nair | CTO | Engineering | p.nair@meridiananalytics.io |
| Rachel Kim | VP of Sales | Sales | r.kim@meridiananalytics.io |
| Hannah Park | Head of Product | Product | h.park@meridiananalytics.io |
| Claire Fontaine | CFO | Finance | c.fontaine@meridiananalytics.io |

For IT issues: open a ticket in the `#it-help` Slack channel.

---

## Policies Summary

- **Working hours:** Core hours are 10 am – 4 pm local time. Flexible outside these times.
- **Expenses:** Submit expenses within 30 days of purchase via Ramp. Meals > $75 require prior approval. Hardware purchases > $300 require manager sign-off.
- **PTO:** 20 days per year (accrued monthly). Submit requests in Rippling ≥ 5 business days in advance for planned leave.
- **Remote work:** Fully remote-friendly. Office available Tuesday–Thursday.
- **Confidentiality:** All employees sign an NDA on Day 1. Do not share customer data, deal information, or financial figures outside the company.
- **Code of Conduct:** Reviewed during Week 1 training. Zero tolerance for harassment.

For the full policy list see the Company Handbook in Notion.

---

That's the full onboarding guide! Note that I don't currently have a connected email or messaging application to send this directly to Emily Carter — you'll need to copy the contents above and send them to her through your preferred channel (e.g., email or Slack).
